admission_rule_A1.reading: The overall FAIL is expected and is the amendment working as written: MiniLM and mpnet claim the Paper A/E1 pinned path and match it at ~1e-7, so their shards are admissible on parity. gte-base and mxbai-embed-large run under declared fresh fp32 GPU numerics (A1), so parity is not claimed for them; the gate instead MEASURES their seam against the pinned path — max |delta cos| 3.63e-04 (gte) and 4.47e-04 (mxbai), the fp16-native quantum documented in the H4 parity lesson. These two numbers are published beside every gte/mxbai figure and beside the L=64 bridge to Paper A, per A1.
admission_rule_A1.admission: ALL FOUR AGORA CONFIGS ADMISSIBLE: two on parity, two on the A1 declaration with the seam disclosed.
